plotEn:
In coastal Queensland during the 1990s, ten-year-old Petey encounters a small extraterrestrial after seeing an object fall from the sky. He names the creature Allen and forms a close friendship with him, eventually introducing him to his brother Jaden and their friend Carly. Allen later disappears without warning.
Twenty years later, Petey remains preoccupied with the possibility that Allen will return. His attempts to contact his childhood friend have left him increasingly disconnected from the people around him, while Jaden and Carly have moved on with their lives. Allen eventually returns, but the reunion is complicated by the reason for his return, forcing Petey to confront his attachment to the past and his relationships in the present.
